title: Export Persona Workspace & Slices Architecture
subtitle: Persona Navigation, Slice Tool, Layer Slices & Bounding Box Tracking

learningObjectives: Navigate the specialized Export Persona workspace and understand its dedicated toolset.
Distinguish between Document Slices, Artboard Slices, User Custom Slices, and Layer-Based Slices.
Generate dynamic Layer-Based Slices that automatically track vector group bounding box modifications.
Manage slice visibility, naming conventions, and export targets within the Slices Studio.
standardSections.foundationalKnowledge: In traditional design software, exporting individual graphic assets—such as icons, UI buttons, and marketing hero banners—from a complex document required tedious manual crop-and-save rituals or running clunky third-party scripts. Affinity Designer eliminates this entire friction layer through the Export Persona (accessible via the top-left Toolbar icon). In this dedicated workspace, slicing is treated as a first-class citizen. You can manually draw slices with the Slice Tool (S), or better yet, convert any vector layer into a 'Layer-Based Slice' in the Slices Studio. Unlike static rectangular coordinates, a layer-based slice dynamically hugs the exact mathematical bounding box of the vector object, updating its export dimensions automatically if the artwork is resized or moved on canvas.

technicalEvidence.source: Affinity Designer 3.3.3 Export Persona & Slices Architecture Specification

shortcut.win: Click Export Persona icon (Top-Left) / Custom shortcut in Edit > Preferences > Shortcuts. Tool: S (Slice Tool), Shift+S (Slice Select)
shortcut.mac: Click Export Persona icon (Top-Left) / Custom shortcut in Affinity Designer > Settings > Shortcuts. Tool: S (Slice Tool), Shift+S (Slice Select)

toolAndFeatureExplanation.description: Dedicated export environment providing slice creation, bounding box tracking, and batch multi-format configuration. Note: Affinity Designer does not assign default keyboard shortcuts for switching personas out of the box.
contextBarOptions: Slice Tool (S): Interactively draws rectangular slice zones on canvas
Slice Selection Tool: Selects, resizes, and repositions existing slice bounding boxes
Slices Studio: Displays full directory tree of all active slices with individual export toggles
Export Options Studio: Configures default format presets (PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG, PDF)
Create Slice button: Located in the Layers Studio tab inside Export Persona

stepByStepInstructions.title: Switch to Export Persona
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Open a document containing multiple icons or UI components. Click the third icon on the top-left Persona toolbar (Export Persona), or press your custom shortcut if configured in Preferences. Notice the top toolbar and left tool dock reconfigure exclusively for slicing.

stepByStepInstructions.title: Inspect Default Document & Artboard Slices
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: In the right studio dock, open the Slices Studio. Notice that Designer has already automatically created a full-canvas slice, as well as individual slices for each artboard present in the document.

stepByStepInstructions.title: Create a Dynamic Layer-Based Slice
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: In the Export Persona, click on the 'Layers' tab in the right dock. Select a vector button or icon group ('Component_Button_Primary'). At the bottom of the panel, click the 'Create Slice' button. Switch back to the 'Slices' tab: an exact-fit slice labeled after your layer is created!

stepByStepInstructions.title: Verify Bounding Box Tracking
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Click the Designer Persona icon on the top-left toolbar to return to drawing mode. Select the button with the Move Tool and stretch its width from 160px to 220px. Switch back to Export Persona: observe that the slice bounding box has expanded dynamically to exactly 220px!

stepByStepInstructions.title: Draw a Manual Custom Slice with the Slice Tool
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Select the Slice Tool (S) on the left toolbar. Click and drag a marquee over a specific sub-region of your illustration (e.g. a focal badge). A new user slice is generated in the Slices Studio, ready for custom naming and export.

visualExamples.title: Slice Architecture Taxonomy
visualExamples.description: Comparison of the four distinct slice classifications in Affinity Designer.
visualExamples.visualContent:
| Slice Type | Origin | Dynamic Tracking | Best Use Case |
|---|---|---|---|
| Document Slice | Automatically generated | Tracks global canvas or bleed bounds | Full layout proofs, complete poster exports |
| Artboard Slice | Automatically generated | Tracks artboard dimensions dynamically | Multi-screen app mockups, responsive viewports |
| Layer-Based Slice | Created via Layers tab -> Create Slice | Hugs exact vector object bounding box dynamically | UI component buttons, system icons, logo lockups |
| User Custom Slice | Drawn manually with Slice Tool (S) | Static rectangular coordinates on canvas | Bespoke detail crops, zoomed marketing previews |

visualExamples.title: Dynamic Layer Bounding Box Tracking Flowchart
visualExamples.description: How layer edits propagate into slice dimensions automatically.
visualExamples.visualContent:

guidedPractice.title: Setting Up an App Asset Slice Catalog
guidedPractice.taskDescription: Establish a production-ready slice catalog for an icon navigation bar containing 5 distinct system icons.
checkpoints: In Designer Persona, organize 5 icons into semantic groups ('Nav_Home', 'Nav_Search', 'Nav_Feed', 'Nav_Notifications', 'Nav_Profile').
Switch to Export Persona by clicking the Export Persona icon on the top-left Toolbar.
In the Layers tab, select all 5 icon groups and click 'Create Slice'.
In the Slices Studio, verify that 5 individual layer-based slices are listed with clean naming.
Uncheck the default Document Slice so only the 5 icons will export.
guidedPractice.expectedOutcome: A streamlined slice manifest where only the 5 intended asset slices are active and calibrated to their exact vector geometry.

independentChallenge.title: Multi-Artboard Enterprise Dashboard Slicing
independentChallenge.prompt: Construct a full production slicing architecture: (1) Set up an enterprise dashboard document containing 3 artboards ('Desktop_1440', 'Tablet_768', 'Mobile_375'); (2) Ensure each artboard contains header, sidebar, and metric card component groups; (3) In Export Persona, generate artboard slices for all 3 viewports; (4) Generate layer-based slices for the individual metric cards and avatar badges; (5) Name all slices with semantic kebab-case paths (e.g. 'ui-card-revenue', 'nav-icon-home'); (6) Verify that all slices track their parent geometry without clipping drop shadows or outer glows.

commonPitfalls.mistake: Drawing manual slices over components instead of creating Layer-Based Slices.
commonPitfalls.consequence: If you later nudge or resize the component on canvas, the manual slice stays behind, cropping the art awkwardly.
commonPitfalls.solution: Always select the layer in Export Persona's Layers tab and click 'Create Slice'. It will track the object wherever it moves.

commonPitfalls.mistake: Leaving all default slices checked when clicking Export Slices.
commonPitfalls.consequence: Exports gigabytes of unwanted full-canvas background files along with your intended icons.
commonPitfalls.solution: Uncheck the top-level 'Document' or 'Artboards' checkboxes in the Slices Studio so only desired component slices export.

commonPitfalls.mistake: Forgetting that outer layer effects (like Outer Glow or Drop Shadow) expand the layer's bounding box.
commonPitfalls.consequence: The slice size may be slightly larger than the raw vector geometry to accommodate the soft blurred shadow pixels.
commonPitfalls.solution: This is intended behavior so shadows are not cut off. If you need hard integer dimensions, clip the shadow inside a vector container.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the primary advantage of a 'Layer-Based Slice' over a user-drawn manual slice in Affinity Designer?
options: Layer-based slices can only export in black and white.
Layer-based slices automatically track the position and bounding box dimensions of the vector object if it is resized or moved.
Layer-based slices permanently lock the document so no other edits can occur.
Layer-based slices only work on macOS.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: A layer-based slice dynamically hugs the parent layer's bounding box; moving, nudging, or resizing the layer in Designer Persona automatically updates the slice bounds without manual adjustment.

knowledgeCheck.question: How do you switch into the Export Persona in Affinity Designer by default?
options: Click the Export Persona icon on the top-left Toolbar (Affinity has no default shortcut out of the box, but custom shortcuts can be configured in Preferences)
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Affinity Designer does not assign default keyboard shortcuts for switching between Personas out of the box. Users switch by clicking the persona icons on the top-left toolbar, or by assigning custom shortcuts in Preferences > Keyboard Shortcuts.

knowledgeCheck.question: Where do you find the 'Create Slice' command to convert an existing vector group into a dynamic slice inside Export Persona?
options: At the bottom of the 'Layers' tab inside the Export Persona studio dock.
In the Swatches Studio palette menu.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Inside the Export Persona, switch to the 'Layers' tab, select any layer or group, and click the 'Create Slice' button located at the bottom of the panel.

keyTakeaways: The Export Persona provides a dedicated, non-destructive slicing and asset generation environment.
Layer-based slices dynamically track vector object dimensions and movements.
Artboards automatically generate dedicated full-screen slice boundaries.
Unchecking unwanted slices in the Slices Studio prevents accidental bloat during batch export.

slides.title: Welcome to the Export Persona
slides.subtitle: Professional Production Output Engineering
bullets: In traditional design apps, exporting individual assets requires tedious manual cropping.
Affinity Designer elevates asset production into a dedicated environment: the Export Persona.
Slicing is non-destructive, persistent, and decoupled from your creative drawing canvas.
Access via the top-left Toolbar icon or assign custom shortcuts in Preferences.
slides.proTip: The Export Persona keeps your main drawing workspace 100% clean of slicing clutter.

slides.title: Workspace Layout & Dedicated Tools
slides.subtitle: The Slicing Command Center
bullets: Left Toolbar: Slice Tool (S) for manual drawing, Slice Selection Tool for tweaking.
Right Studios: Slices Studio (manages all slices) and Export Options Studio (preset defaults).
Layers Tab in Export Persona: Allows you to convert any vector layer into a dynamic slice.
Canvas Viewport: Highlights active slice zones with cyan/orange bounding rectangles.
slides.proTip: Return to Designer Persona anytime by clicking the first icon on the top-left Persona Toolbar.

slides.title: The Four Types of Slices
slides.subtitle: Document, Artboards, Layers & Custom
bullets: Document Slice: Full canvas bounds for master document proofs and posters.
Artboard Slices: Automatically created for every artboard; auto-updates if artboard is resized.
Layer-Based Slices: Created from specific layers; dynamically tracks object bounds.
User Custom Slices: Drawn manually with the Slice Tool (S) to capture arbitrary regions.
slides.callout: Use Layer-Based Slices for 95% of your UI icons, badges, and components!

slides.title: Creating Dynamic Layer-Based Slices
slides.subtitle: Zero-Maintenance Asset Bounding Boxes
bullets: Inside Export Persona, click the 'Layers' tab in the right dock.
Select your icon or button group (e.g. 'Btn_Primary_Action').
Click the 'Create Slice' button at the bottom of the panel.
A slice is generated that perfectly hugs the outer boundaries of the vector shapes.
slides.proTip: Select multiple layers at once and click 'Create Slice' to batch-generate dozens of slices in 1 second.

slides.title: Live Bounding Box Tracking in Action
slides.subtitle: Never Re-Crop an Asset Again
bullets: Return to Designer Persona via the top-left Toolbar icon.
Move the button to another artboard or stretch its width from 160px to 220px.
Switch back to Export Persona via the top-left Toolbar icon.
The slice rectangle has automatically updated its coordinates and dimensions to 220px!
slides.callout: Manual user-drawn slices do NOT track objects; always prefer layer-based slices!

slides.title: Managing the Slices Studio Manifest
slides.subtitle: Organizing Export Targets
bullets: The Slices Studio lists every slice with a checkbox and thumbnail preview.
Uncheck slices you do not want to export during the current build.
Rename slice labels to match your developer asset naming specs (e.g. 'icon-search').
Drag slices into logical groups to mirror your design system folder hierarchy.
slides.proTip: Use kebab-case ('btn-save-draft') for clean cross-platform developer handoff.
